channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Presentation: The Right 300 Tokens Beat 100k Noisy Ones: The Architecture of Context Engineering
item.description: Baruch Sadogursky and Patrick Debois discuss why coding agents fail due to bloated context windows and stuffed prompts. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Kubeflow Expands AI Capabilities as CNCF Graduation Nears
item.description: The Kubeflow project has unveiled several technical updates to enhance distributed AI and high-performance computing on Kubernetes. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: What 50 open source projects taught us about security in the AI era
item.description: See how the open source projects in Session 4 of the GitHub Secure Open Source Fund combined AI-assisted workflows, maintainer expertise, GitHub security tools, expert guidance, and funding to improve project security. (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Total eclipse of the Internet: traffic impacts in Iceland, Spain, and Portugal
item.description: Cloudflare's data shows a clear impact on Internet traffic from Iceland to Spain and Portugal, following the path of totality of the total solar eclipse that occurred on August 12, 2026. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Your guide to GitHub Universe 2026 is here: The schedule just launched!
item.description: The GitHub Universe session catalog is live. Explore interactive workshops, community talks, demos, and panels. Plus, register before August 19 to save $300. The post Your guide to GitHub Universe 2026 is here: The schedule just launched! (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available
item.description: Cloudflare's Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available. The biggest change: we no longer email you about certificates Cloudflare issued for your domain, so when an alert lands in your inbox, it's worth a look. (1 source: cloudflare)
